module.Title: Read an Operator Command
module.Teaching: std::cin reads keyboard input. The >> operator extracts a value from the input stream and stores it in the variable on the right.
module.PredictionQuestion: Where is the operator input stored?
module.PredictionExplanation: The extraction operator places the entered integer into targetRpm.
module.DebugPrompt: Input uses >> because data moves from std::cin into the variable.
module.RecallPrompt: Create the exact int variable targetRpm with the starting value 0, then use the exact identifiers std and cin as std::cin to read into targetRpm.
module.TransferPrompt: Create the exact std::string variable command, then use the exact identifiers std and cin as std::cin to read one word into command.
module.PreviewMessage: The operator console can now send commands into the simulation.
